name: planta
description: Photograph a leaf and identify crop diseases.
author: Planta

scripts.electron:dev: concurrently -k -s first "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && wait-on http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/health && cross-env ELECTRON_START_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.electron:pack: npm run build:web && npm run bundle:python && electron-builder --dir --publish never
scripts.electron:build: npm run build:web && npm run bundle:python && electron-builder --publish never
scripts.electron:build:mac: npm run build:web && npm run bundle:python && electron-builder --mac --publish never
scripts.electron:build:win: npm run build:web && npm run bundle:python && electron-builder --win --publish never

extendInfo.NSCameraUsageDescription: Planta uses the camera to photograph plant leaves for disease identification.
